purpose: decide where P2's route quality and computing cost stand under the same complete residual task, and whether the short-budget gap comes from an unfinished construction/search or from a quality gap after natural termination
not_claimed: any method is the domain best
the micro fixtures are a performance set

model.grid: four-neighbour, equal unit steps, arriving on a target cell covers it
model.task: complete the same current checkable residual targets Q=(P-C) and F and return to the same base
model.history: the real coverage ledger and the real old remaining route are inputs for every method; no SEED/PLUS1 style scope selection this round
model.information: only the currently published map is visible

seed_meaning: the seed is passed to every method; P2/OARP/GLNS use it for their randomised stages, TREE_MST and PPCPP_CORE4 are deterministic and ignore it. Two seeds are not a statistical power claim.
method_order_rule: for case index i and seed index j the method order is ORDER rotated left by (i+j) mod 5; ORDER = P2_MULTI -> TREE_MST -> OARP_CORE2 -> PPCPP_CORE4 -> EPSILON_STAR

preflight.purpose: runner / records / legality only, no performance screening

timing.call_total_seconds: public entry to the finished pre-return output check, including input validation, preprocessing, construction, search, connector, return and the audit
timing.adapter_call_seconds: the adapter's own measure, a subset of call_total
timing.excluded: ledger disk writes, the external post-hoc audit and the process start-up
timing.process_startup: recorded per task by the parent as wall minus call_total

budget_verdict: a call counts as in-budget only when call_total_seconds <= the public soft limit; later calls keep their produced route but are reported with within_budget=false and the overrun in seconds

taxonomy.natural_complete_valid: the engine's own termination was reached and the route is legal, complete and within the resource
taxonomy.truncated_with_valid_candidate: a time/iteration cap fired but a legal complete route was already produced
taxonomy.no_valid_route: no legal complete route was produced
taxonomy.input_precondition_rejected: the method's own input precondition was not met
taxonomy.environment_infeasible: the base or an outstanding target is unreachable (reported by the independent reachability check, not by the planner)

stop_rules.hard_cap: the parent kills a task at the per-batch hard cap and records a hard_timeout end row; the route is not used
stop_rules.wall_clock: no new task starts after 6 h from the batch start; the remaining list is kept as not started
stop_rules.no_retry: a failed task is not retried, a successful task is not rerun, and a task that never started gets no fabricated failure row
stop_rules.early_stop: if LONG120 shows a runner or semantic defect the later two batches are not started

cache_policy.per_batch_cache: each batch runs with its own TEMP/TMP and cache directory under NEW/tmp/cache/<batch>
cache_policy.graph_independent_dependency: OARP_CORE2 reads the frozen runtime_profile.json (an offline calibration constant); it is graph independent and is disclosed, not recomputed
cache_policy.no_cross_method_sharing: no distance matrix, route or optimisation state is shared between methods or batches

ledger.seal: prefix bytes + lines + SHA256 per batch
